title: Stability of Schwarzschild Black Holes Under Perturbation
exact_target: Determine whether a small vacuum perturbation of Schwarzschild initial data still has complete future null infinity and a nonempty black-hole region.

status_qualification: The smallness norm and asymptotic data class are not specified by this rough report formulation. Both completeness and nonempty black-hole region must be retained; linear stability or one restricted nonlinear data class does not alone settle the entire stated question.
